TokenVester¶

Git Source

Inherits: Ownable

Handles token vesting with cliff and gradual release

State Variables¶

token¶

IERC20 public immutable token;

start¶

uint256 public immutable start;

cliffDuration¶

uint256 public immutable cliffDuration;

initialRelease¶

uint256 public immutable initialRelease;

totalAllocation¶

uint256 public immutable totalAllocation;

vestingDuration¶

uint256 public immutable vestingDuration;

released¶

uint256 public released;

Functions¶

constructor¶

Initializes the vesting contract

constructor(
    IERC20 _token,
    uint256 _cliffDuration,
    uint256 _initialRelease,
    uint256 _totalAllocation,
    uint256 _vestingDuration,
    address _owner
) Ownable(_owner);

Parameters

Name

Type

Description

_token

IERC20

The token to be vested

_cliffDuration

uint256

The time before vesting starts

_initialRelease

uint256

The initial release amount

_totalAllocation

uint256

Total amount allocated for vesting

_vestingDuration

uint256

Duration of the vesting period

_owner

address

Owner of the contract

release¶

Releases vested tokens

function release() external onlyOwner;

function calculateVestedAmount() public view returns (uint256);
